import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. The placeholders {title} and # {body} will be replaced with the sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Format a user‑submitted blog post for safe display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- post_title : str The headline or title of the blog post. post_body : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post. Notes ----- - All user input is escaped using :func:`html.escape` to prevent XSS attacks. This includes the title, body and any other user supplied content that might be inserted into the template. - The function does not modify formatting such as line breaks or Markdown; it simply inserts the escaped content into the template. """ # Escape user input to neutralize any malicious HTML/JS safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
